svg.title: Dice Witch Circle — clickable paint-by-number
svg.desc: Polyhedral dice orbit a pentacle-like magical circle with stars and a glowing center. Click a numbered region to toggle its suggested color. Shift-click paints every region with the same number.

svg.text: Dice Witch Circle • click a cell • Shift-click a whole number
